composition: stage_execution.PreparationResolver answers the orchestration from the stage alone (cheap, resolving nothing, because ManagedPreparation reads the intent first) and composes operands from the deployment's own readers: line, accepted integration checkpoint, published proposal, Authority canonical target, required-test selection, Job limits. It is RECOVERY-FIRST: with a committed intent it resolves NOTHING and leaves the request for _recovered; only a first sweep reads the target and publishes. integration_worker.preparation_child_work derives the first sweep's child Work with the authority's prefix, for the window before the intent commits.
corrections_made: changed-child refusal is a DISTINCT invariant from moved-target recovery and I had collapsed them: the replacement case exercised _recovered alone and never reached _preserved's child comparison. Now driven through the whole of _preserved with a VALID published input.

my 'unchanged sweep' case passed None for the intent despite creating one, so it proved absence passthrough while reading as resume agreement. Renamed to test_an_absent_intent_carries_no_constraint; the honest agreement case with a real intent and publication lives where a bundle exists. A guard that only refuses passes every refusal test and breaks every resume.
the obsolete moved-target refusal is NOT restored
